requirement.description: The Flask hook is not properly detecting and hooking Flask application view functions and error handlers. The tests expect that when a Flask application is running, its route handlers and error handlers are correctly intercepted and labeled in the HTTP records. Currently, the hook is not properly identifying Flask apps in the global namespace and hooking their functions.
requirement.contract: The hook_flask function must properly detect Flask application instances regardless of how they're defined and hook their view functions and error handlers. When a Flask app is detected, all route handlers and error handlers defined on that app must be wrapped with the httpdbg hook mechanism so they can be properly recorded with their labels (e.g., '@app.route("/")' or '@app.errorhandler(404)'). The hook should work for Flask apps defined in various ways, including those created in global scope, within functions, or in separate modules.
